Roof Repairs

We repair roofs with the right materials so the repair lasts: new lead where the old lead has failed, not flashband stuck over the top. Because we remove spray foam too, we can repair what turns up underneath it.

Repairs That Last

A lot of the roofing problems we see come down to a lack of roofing knowledge and poor workmanship. Some contractors do quick repairs that don't work, just to make money, and the customer is left with the same problem and more cost.

We often find old, worn-out leadwork left in place when it should have been replaced, and cheap flashband used instead of lead flashing. We'd rather do the job right first time, with quality materials and the right methods.

Problems Found Under the Foam

Spray foam hides the underside of a roof, and once it's off the roof has to be looked at. Because the same directly employed team removes foam and repairs roofs, a problem found on the day can be dealt with there and then. Two of our customers explain what that looked like for them below.

Repair or Replace?

If you're not sure whether the roof needs repairs or a full replacement, a survey will tell you. We don't automatically recommend expensive work: we tell you what needs attention and what doesn't.

Signs a Roof Needs Repairing

  • Water coming through a ceiling or into the loft
  • Old leadwork that has cracked or lifted
  • Flashband where there should be lead flashing
  • Slipped, cracked or missing tiles
